CustomField.description: This formula Caclulates the number of payments to be made for the contract in total
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(SM_Way_of_AC_Payment__c, "One payment"),1,2) +IF(StartDate >SM_Start_date__c, ((YEAR( Contract_End_Date_Calculated__c ) - YEAR(StartDate ))*12) + (MONTH(Contract_End_Date_Calculated__c ) - MONTH( StartDate )), ((YEAR( Contract_End_Date_Calculated__c ) - YEAR(SM_Start_date__c))*12) + (MONTH(Contract_End_Date_Calculated__c ) - MONTH( SM_Start_date__c)) )
CustomField.label: Count Months in Suscription
